-"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" **Result replay notifications** — after the `ui/initialize` reply the host posts `ui/notifications/"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"tool-input` and `ui/notifications/tool-result` in FIFO order; new-spec cards ignore `lastToolResult`"},{"id":"p5s6","text":" and subscribe to these notifications only, so late-mounting cards (replay / injected sessions) stil"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"l restore the tool result
- **Session ID injection** — automatically injects `session_id` into card-"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"initiated `tools/call`
- **Invisible context injection** — `ui/update-model-context` context injecte"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"d as a plugin-sourced message via `agent.inject()`, classified as a collapsed context row (not a vis"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"ible user message bubble)
- **HTTP bridge endpoint** — `/mcp-apps/<serverName>/bridge` for secure if"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"rame-to-MCP-server proxying (CORS-enabled for sandboxed cards that fetch it directly)
- **Bridge deb"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"ug log** — `GET /mcp-apps/<serverName>/debug` returns the last 64 bridge exchanges; bridge calls byp"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"ass the agent pipeline and never reach the session JSONL, so this endpoint is the only place card-in"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"itiated `tools/call`s are observable
- **Multi-instance safe** — each plugin instance registers its "},{"id":"p5s15","text":"own per-server bridge route, so several MCP Apps servers can coexist in one DSH profile
- **stdio + "},{"id":"p5s16","text":"streamable-http** — supports both MCP transport types"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"What a tool result carrying an embedded card looks like in the conversation:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The screenshot shows both cards of the bundled demo server (`demo/server.mjs` — zero dependencies, N"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"hows both cards of the bundled demo server (`demo/server.mjs` — zero dependencies, Node stdio only):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- `demo_interactive` (**inline form**): the tool *result* carries `_meta.ui.resource.text`, so the c"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ard HTML rides the result. Its buttons exercise the full bridge round trip: a `tools/call` that refr"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"eshes the card (the host auto-injects `session_id`), and `ui/update-model-context` + `ui/message` ta"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"lking back to the model.
